question: Can the current dirty worktree be made reviewable while preventing unresolved tracked historical-evidence deletions from entering a baseline commit?
hypothesis: A read-only Git inventory plus an owner-adjudication guard can enumerate all relevant drift and fail closed without restoring, deleting, staging, or rewriting evidence.
mutation_scope: Generated X0 run artifacts only; repository sources and historical evidence are read-only.
claim_boundary: Supports reviewability, protected-deletion adjudication evidence, and an explicitly owner-reviewed B1 commit pin. It never auto-approves restore/deletion, never includes the dirty worktree in B1, and does not support task-quality/economic claims.
source_inputs: current working-tree references under project documentation/config roots
